text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a national-scale, spatially explicit assessment of future land-use and land-cover (LULC) change in Brazil through 2050 using the GLOBIOM-Brazil model. Its primary objective is to simulate and compare multiple future scenarios—including full enforcement vs. non-enforcement of Brazil’s Forest Code—and quantify resulting changes in native vegetation, cropland, and pasture. The modeling is implemented on a 50 km × 50 km grid covering the entire country, with mapped projections of deforestation, restoration, and agricultural expansion. It includes ≥2 quantitative future scenarios (e.g., FC, NoFC, IDCAmazon, etc.), reports explicit change metrics (e.g., 53.4 Mha of avoided deforestation), validates model outputs against historical data (e.g., PRODES), and produces spatially explicit LULC projections. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
